name: Knaves
description: Knaves is a fast-paced trick-taking card game for three players. It is an avoidance game where the primary objective is to gain points for tricks while avoiding the 'Knaves' (Jacks), which carry heavy negative scores. It blends traditional trick-play with the high-stakes risk-management found in games like Hearts.

content.text: Knaves is a fast-paced trick-taking card game for three players. It is an avoidance game where the primary objective is to gain points for tricks while avoiding the 'Knaves' (Jacks), which carry heavy negative scores. It blends traditional trick-play with the high-stakes risk-management found in games like Hearts.
Dates to the early 1900s. It was popularized as a 'social' card game that simplified the complexity of Bridge or Whist, adding a more humorous 'hot potato' element with the penalty Jacks.

items.text: Four-Player Knaves: Use a full 52-card deck (13 cards each).
Reverse Knaves: Winning Jacks gives positive points, tricks give negative.
Super Knaves: Bonus penalties for the Queen of Spades (Hearts style).
